items.title: This Is Your Brain on Psychedelics
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, Gary O'Reilly, Gül Dölen
items.content:
What if you could reopen your childhood brain? Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, and Gary O’Reilly explore the cutting edge of psychedelic science, critical periods, and what a high octopus can teach us about the human mind with neuroscientist and psychedelics expert Gül Dölen.

NOTE: StarTalk+ Patrons can listen to this entire episode commercial-free here:  https://startalkmedia.com/show/this-is-your-brain-on-psychedelics/

items.title: Solving AI’s Energy Problem with Kathryn Huff
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Paul Mecurio, Gary O'Reilly, Kathryn Huff
items.content:
Is nuclear power the key to sustainability? With data centers consuming massive amounts of energy, can we keep up? Neil deGrasse Tyson, Gary O’Reilly & Paul Mecurio discuss the physics, safety, and future of nuclear reactors in a world of increasing power demands with nuclear engineer Kathryn Huff.

Originally Aired February 21, 2025.

items.title: The Hunt for Dark Energy with Jason Rhodes
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Paul Mecurio, Jason Rhodes
items.content:

items.title: Your Inner Cosmos with David Eagleman
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, Gary O'Reilly, David Eagleman
items.content:
